evidence.quote: Troxy first opened its doors in 1933
Our building has step-free access via the front entrance, and throughout the upper section of the ground floor.
Our accessible toilet is located in the left-hand side of the foyer through the main entrance, and is accessible via Radar key.

findings.value: The Circle is reached only by 43 steps, with no lift; Front Stalls are three steps down, so they are not step-free. The accessible toilet is opened with a Radar key, and a spare can be borrowed from security. A hearing loop is at the box office window only. BSL or audio description can be arranged on request. One free carer ticket per accessible ticket.

evidence.quote: this can only be accessed via 43 steps to our upper level
Please note that Front Stalls tickets are not step-free accessible, as the lower ground floor area at the front of the auditorium is only accessible via 3 steps down from the upper ground floor.

findings.value: Tickets are sold online only, with no phone sales; the box office can help with online bookings by phone or email.

evidence.quote: digital only venue. If you require help with booking your tickets through our website, feel free to call or email us.
